criteria.text: A reviewed independent issue is current and dependency-clear; an unchecked issue is not eligible.
CRM issue 42 waits for schema issue 42 in another repository; completed work releases the native blocker, but not-planned, unknown, reopened or required-deployment work does not.
A native human edge with no saved reason remains visible. Merge alone does not satisfy an open prerequisite.
Self edges, duplicate additions and same- or cross-repository cycles are refused. Existing native cycles remain visible.
Claims, open PRs, stuck work, unknown trust and incomplete reads keep their separate holds and do not become eligible.
